name: Dual Review
description: Two parallel reviewers cross-verify findings and adjudicate disagreements into a merged report.
goal: Produce a merged adversarial code review from dual independent reviewers

variables.name: review_scope
variables.default: Review the code changes in the working directory

runAgentConfig.prompt:
Perform an adversarial code review focused on correctness and security. Scope: {{var:review_scope}}

Identify bugs, logic errors, security vulnerabilities, and data-handling risks. Rank findings by severity.

Perform an adversarial code review focused on code quality and maintainability. Scope: {{var:review_scope}}

Identify readability issues, design problems, missing tests, and technical debt. Rank findings by severity.
